verses.geez:
ወወረደ ፡ ሶምሶን ፡ ውስተ ፡ ተምናታ ፡ ወርእየ ፡ ብእሲተ ፡ በተምናታ ፡ እምነ ፡ አዋልደ ፡ አሎፍል ፡ ወአደመቶ ፡
                  ቅድሜሁ ።
verses.translation: And Sampson went down to Thamnatha, and saw a woman in Thamnatha of the daughters of the Philistines.

translations.lxx: And Sampson went down to Thamnatha, and saw a woman in Thamnatha of the daughters of the Philistines.
translations.kjv: And Samson went down to Timnath, and saw a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines.
translations.ron: În vremea aceea s-a dus Samson la Timna şi a văzut în Timna o femeie din fiicele Filistenilor şi aceasta i-a plăcut.
translations.grk: Καὶ κατέβη Σαμψὼν εἰς Θαμναθὰ, καὶ εἶδε γυναῖκα ἐν Θαμναθὰ ἀπὸ τῶν θυγατέρων τῶν ἀλλοφύλων.

verses.geez:
ወዐርገ ፡ ወነገሮሙ ፡ ለአቡሁ ፡ ወለእሙ ፡ ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ርኢኩ ፡ ብእሲተ ፡ በተምናታ ፡ እምነ ፡ አዋልደ ፡ አሎፍል ፡
                  ወይእዜኒ ፡ ንሥእዋ ፡ ሊተ ፡ ብእሲተ ።
verses.translation: And he went up and told his father and his mother, and said, I have seen a woman in Thamnatha of the daughters of the Phylistines; and now take her to me for a wife.

translations.lxx: And he went up and told his father and his mother, and said, I have seen a woman in Thamnatha of the daughters of the Phylistines; and now take her to me for a wife.
translations.kjv: And he came up, and told his father and his mother, and said, I have seen a woman in Timnath of the daughters of the Philistines: now therefore get her for me to wife.
translations.ron: Şi s-a dus şi a spus el tatălui său şi mamei sale şi a zis: "Am văzut în Timna o femeie din fiicele Filistenilor; luaţi-mi-o mie de soţie!"
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀνέβη καὶ ἀπήγγειλε τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ τῇ μητρὶ αὐτοῦ, καὶ εἶπε, γυναῖκα ἑώρακα ἐν Θαμναθὰ ἀπὸ τῶν θυγατέρων Φυλιστιῒμ, καὶ νῦν λάβετε αὐτήν μοι εἰς γυναῖκα.

verses.geez:
ወይቤልዎ ፡ አቡሁ ፡ ወእሙ ፡ ቦኑ ፡ አልቦ ፡ እምነ ፡ አዋልደ ፡ አኀዊከ ፡ ወበውስተ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሕዝብየ ፡ ብእሲተ ፡
                  ከመ ፡ ትሑር ፡ አንተ ፡ ወትንሣእ ፡ ብእሲተ ፡ እምነ ፡ አዋልደ ፡ አሎፍል ፡ ቈላፍያን ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ሶምሶን ፡ ለአቡሁ ፡
                  ኪያሃ ፡ ዳእሙ ፡ ንሥኡ ፡ ሊተ ፡ እስመ ፡ አደመተኒ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አዕይንትየ ።
verses.translation: And his father and his mother said to him, Are there no daughters of thy brethren, and is there not a woman of all my people, that thou goest to take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines? And Sampson said to his father, Take her for me, for she is right in my eyes.

translations.lxx: And his father and his mother said to him, Are there no daughters of thy brethren, and is there not a woman of all my people, that thou goest to take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines? And Sampson said to his father, Take her for me, for she is right in my eyes.
translations.kjv: Then his father and his mother said unto him, Is there never a woman among the daughters of thy brethren, or among all my people, that thou goest to take a wife of the uncircumcised Philistines? And Samson said unto his father, Get her for me; for she pleaseth me well.
translations.ron: Iar tatăl său şi mama sa i-au răspuns: "Au doară nu se găsesc femei printre fiicele fraţilor tăi şi în tot poporul meu, de te duci să-ţi iei soţie de la Filistenii cei netăiaţi împrejur?" A zis Samson către tatăl său: "Ia-mi-o pe aceea, pentru că mi-a plăcut!"
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ, μὴ οὐκ εἰσὶ θυγατέρες τῶν ἀδελφῶν σου, καὶ ἐκ παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ μου γυνὴ, ὅτι συ πορεύῃ λαβεῖν γυναῖκα ἀπὸ τῶν ἀλλοφύλων τῶν ἀπεριτμήτων; Καὶ εἶπε Σαμψὼν πρὸς τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ, ταύτην λάβε μοι, ὅτι αὕτη εὐθεῖα ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς μου.

verses.geez:
ወኢያእመሩ ፡ አቡሁ ፡ ወእሙ ፡ ከመ ፡ እምኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ውእቱ ፡ እስመ ፡ በቀለ ፡ ይፈቅድ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ እምነ ፡
                  አሎፍል ፡ ወበእማንቱ ፡ መዋዕል ፡ አሎፍል ፡ ይቀንይዎሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ።
verses.translation: And his father and his mother knew not that it was of the Lord, that he sought to be revenged on the Philistines: and at that time the Philistines lorded it over Israel.

translations.lxx: And his father and his mother knew not that it was of the Lord, that he sought to be revenged on the Philistines: and at that time the Philistines lorded it over Israel.
translations.kjv: But his father and his mother knew not that it was of the LORD, that he sought an occasion against the Philistines: for at that time the Philistines had dominion over Israel.
translations.ron: Şi nu ştiau tatăl său şi mama sa că aceasta este de la Domnul şi că el caută prilej să se răzbune pe Filisteni. Căci în vremea aceea Filistenii domneau peste Israel.
translations.grk: Καὶ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἔγνωσαν ὅτι παρὰ Κυρίου ἐστὶν, ὅτι ἐκδίκησιν αὐτὸς ζητεῖ ἐκ τῶν ἀλλοφύλων· καὶ ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ οἱ ἀλλόφυλοι κυριεύοντες ἐν Ἰσραήλ.

verses.geez:
ወወረደ ፡ ሶምሶን ፡ ወአቡሁ ፡ ወእሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ተምናታ ፡ ወተግሕሠ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዐጸደ ፡ ወይን ፡ ዘተምናታ ፡ ወናሁ ፡
                  አንበሳ ፡ ተቀበሎ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይጥሕር ።
verses.translation: And Sampson and his father and his mother went down to Thamnatha, and he came to the vineyard of Thamnatha; and behold, a young lion roared in meeting him.

translations.lxx: And Sampson and his father and his mother went down to Thamnatha, and he came to the vineyard of Thamnatha; and behold, a young lion roared in meeting him.
translations.kjv: Then went Samson down, and his father and his mother, to Timnath, and came to the vineyards of Timnath: and, behold, a young lion roared against him.
translations.ron: Deci s-a dus Samson cu tatăl său şi cu mama sa la Timna; iar când s-au apropiat de viile Timnei, iată un leu tânăr venea răcnind înaintea lor.
translations.grk: Καὶ κατέβη Σαμψὼν καὶ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ εἰς Θαμναθά· καὶ ἦλθεν ἕως τοῦ ἀμπελῶνος Θαμναθὰ, καὶ ἰδοὺ σκύμνος λέοντος ὠρυόμενος εἰς συνάντησιν αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወመጽአ ፡ ላዕሌሁ ፡ መንፈሰ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወነፅኆ ፡ ከመ ፡ ዘይነፅኅ ፡ ማሕሥአ ፡ ጠሊ ፡ ወከመ ፡ ወኢምንተ ፡ ኮነ
                  ፡ ውስተ ፡ እዴሁ ፡ ወኢያይድዐ ፡ ለአቡሁ ፡ ወለእሙ ፡ ዘገብረ ።
verses.translation: And the Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon him, and he crushed him as he would have crushed a kid of the goats, and there was nothing in his hands: and he told not his father and his mother what he had done.

translations.lxx: And the Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon him, and he crushed him as he would have crushed a kid of the goats, and there was nothing in his hands: and he told not his father and his mother what he had done.
translations.kjv: And the Spirit of the LORD came mightily upon him, and he rent him as he would have rent a kid, and he had nothing in his hand: but he told not his father or his mother what he had done.
translations.ron: Atunci s-a coborât peste el Duhul Domnului şi el a sfâşiat leul ca pe un ied; şi nu avea nimic în mână. şi n-a spus tatălui său şi mamei sale ce făcuse.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἥλατο ἐπʼ αὐτὸν πνεῦμα Κυρίου, καὶ συνέτριψεν αὐτὸν ὡσεὶ συντρίψει ἔριφον αἰγῶν, καὶ οὐδὲν ἦν ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτοῦ· καὶ οὐκ ἀπήγγειλε τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ τῇ μητρὶ αὐτοῦ ὃ ἐποίησε.

verses.geez: ወዐርጉ ፡ ወተናገሩ ፡ [በእንተ ፡ ብእሲት ፡] ወአደመቶ ፡ ቅድሜሁ ፡ ለሶምሶን ።
verses.translation: And they went down and spoke to the woman, and she was pleasing in the eyes of Sampson.

translations.lxx: And they went down and spoke to the woman, and she was pleasing in the eyes of Sampson.
translations.kjv: And he went down, and talked with the woman; and she pleased Samson well.
translations.ron: Şi a venit şi a vorbit cu femeia şi aceasta a plăcut lui Samson.
translations.grk: Καὶ κατέβησαν καὶ ἐλάλησαν τῇ γυναικὶ, καὶ ηὐθύνθη ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς Σαμψών.

verses.geez:
ወተመይጠ ፡ እምድኅረ ፡ መዋዕል ፡ ከመ ፡ ይንሥኣ ፡ ወተግሕሠ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይርአዮ ፡ ለዝክቱ ፡ በድነ ፡ አንበሳ ፡ ወናሁ
                  ፡ ንህብ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አፉሁ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ አንበሳ ፡ ኀደረ ፡ ወቦ ፡ መዓረ ።
verses.translation: And after some time he returned to take her, and he turned aside to see the carcase of the lion; and behold, a swarm of bees, and honey were in the mouth of the lion.

translations.lxx: And after some time he returned to take her, and he turned aside to see the carcase of the lion; and behold, a swarm of bees, and honey were in the mouth of the lion.
translations.kjv: And after a time he returned to take her, and he turned aside to see the carcase of the lion: and, behold, there was a swarm of bees and honey in the carcase of the lion.
translations.ron: Iar după câteva zile s-a dus el iarăşi ca să o ia şi s-a abătut să vadă trupul leului şi iată un roi de albine şi miere în trupul leului.
translations.grk: Καὶ ὑπέστρεψε μεθʼ ἡμέρας λαβεῖν αὐτὴν, καὶ ἐξέκλινεν ἰδεῖν τὸ πτῶμα τοῦ λέοντος, καὶ ἰδοὺ συναγωγὴ μελισσῶν ἐν τῷ στόματι τοῦ λέοντος καὶ μέλι.

verses.geez:
ወነሥኦ ፡ ወበልዐ ፡ ወሖረ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይበልዕ ፡ ወበጽሐ ፡ ኀበ ፡ አቡሁ ፡ ወእሙ ፡ ወወሀቦሙ ፡ ወበልዑ ፡ ወኢያይድዖሙ
                  ፡ ከመ ፡ እምነ ፡ አፈ ፡ አንበሳ ፡ አውፅኦ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ መዓር ።
verses.translation: And he took it into his hands, and went on eating, and he went to his father and his mother, and gave to them, and they did eat; but he told them not that he took the honey out of the mouth of the lion.

translations.lxx: And he took it into his hands, and went on eating, and he went to his father and his mother, and gave to them, and they did eat; but he told them not that he took the honey out of the mouth of the lion.
translations.kjv: And he took thereof in his hands, and went on eating, and came to his father and mother, and he gave them, and they did eat: but he told not them that he had taken the honey out of the carcase of the lion.
translations.ron: Şi a luat el fagurele în mână şi s-a dus şi a mâncat pe cale; iar dacă a venit la tatăl său şi la mama sa, le-a dat şi lor de au mâncat; dar nu le-a spus că a luat fagurele acesta din trupul leului celui mort.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐξεῖλεν αὐτὸ εἰς χεῖρας αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐπορεύετο πορευόμενος καὶ ἐσθίων· καὶ ἐπορεύθη πρὸς τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ πρὸς τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἔφαγον, καὶ οὐκ ἀπήγγειλεν αὐτοῖς ὅτι ἀπὸ στόματος τοῦ λέοντος ἐξεῖλε τὸ μέλι.

verses.geez:
ወወረደ ፡ አቡሁ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ብእሲት ፡ ወነበረ ፡ ህየ ፡ ሶምሶን ፡ ሰቡዐ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ እስመ ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ይነብሩ
                  ፡ ወራዙት ።
verses.translation: And his father went down to the woman, and Sampson made there a banquet for seven days, for so the young men are used to do.

translations.lxx: And his father went down to the woman, and Sampson made there a banquet for seven days, for so the young men are used to do.
translations.kjv: So his father went down unto the woman: and Samson made there a feast; for so used the young men to do.
translations.ron: Apoi a mers tatăl său la femeie şi a făcut acolo Samson ospăţ de şapte zile, cum au obiceiul să facă mirii.
translations.grk: Καὶ κατέβη ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ πρὸς τὴν γυναῖκα, καὶ ἐποίησεν ἐκεῖ Σαμψὼν πότον ἡμέρας ἑπτὰ, ὅτι οὕτως ποιοῦσιν οἱ νεανίσκοι.

verses.geez: ወእምዝ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ፈርህዎ ፡ ሤሙ ፡ ላዕሌሁ ፡ ካልኣነ ፡ ሠላሳ ፡ ወነበሩ ፡ ምስሌሁ ።
verses.translation: And it came to pass when they saw him, that they took thirty guests, and they were with him.

translations.lxx: And it came to pass when they saw him, that they took thirty guests, and they were with him.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when they saw him, that they brought thirty companions to be with him.
translations.ron: Şi când l-au văzut cei de acolo, au ales treizeci de nuntaşi care să fie împrejurul lui.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγένετο ὅτε εἶδον αὐτὸν, καὶ ἔλαβον τριάκοντα κλητοὺς, καὶ ἦσαν μετʼ αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ሶምሶን ፡ እሜስል ፡ ለክሙ ፡ አምሳለ ፡ ወእመ ፡ አይዳዕክሙኒ ፡ አምሳልየ ፡ በእላንቱ ፡ ሰቡዕ ፡ መዋዕል ፡
                  ዘበዓል ፡ ወረከብክሙ ፡ እሁበክሙ ፡ ፴ሰንዱናተ ፡ ወ፴አልባሰ ።
verses.translation: And Sampson said to them, I propound you a riddle: if ye will indeed tell it me, and discover it within the seven days of the feast, I will give you thirty sheets and thirty changes of raiment.

translations.lxx: And Sampson said to them, I propound you a riddle: if ye will indeed tell it me, and discover it within the seven days of the feast, I will give you thirty sheets and thirty changes of raiment.
translations.kjv: And Samson said unto them, I will now put forth a riddle unto you: if ye can certainly declare it me within the seven days of the feast, and find it out, then I will give you thirty sheets and thirty change of garments:
translations.ron: Iar Samson a zis către ei: "Am să vă spun o ghicitoare şi dacă mi-o veţi ghici în cele şapte zile ale ospăţului şi mi-o veţi dezlega, vă voi da treizeci de cămăşi şi treizeci de rânduri de haine.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Σαμψὼν, πρόβλημα ὑμῖν προβάλλομαι, ἐὰν ἀπαγγέλλοντες ἀπαγγείλητε αὐτὸ ἐν ταῖς ἑπτὰ ἡμέραις τοῦ πότου καὶ εὕρητε, δώσω ὑμῖν τριάκοντα σινδόνας καὶ τριάκοντα στολὰς ἱματίων.

verses.geez:
ወእመሰ ፡ ስእንክሙ ፡ አይድዖትየ ፡ ትሁቡኒ ፡ አንትሙ ፡ ሊተ ፡ ፴ሰንዱናተ ፡ ወ፴አልባሰ ፡ ወይቤልዎ ፡ ምስል ፡
                  አምሳሊከ ፡ ወንስማዕ ።
verses.translation: And if ye cannot tell it me, ye shall give me thirty napkins and thirty changes of apparel: and they said to him, Propound thy riddle, and we will hear it.

translations.lxx: And if ye cannot tell it me, ye shall give me thirty napkins and thirty changes of apparel: and they said to him, Propound thy riddle, and we will hear it.
translations.kjv: But if ye cannot declare it me, then shall ye give me thirty sheets and thirty change of garments. And they said unto him, Put forth thy riddle, that we may hear it.
translations.ron: Iar dacă nu veţi putea s-o ghiciţi, atunci să-mi daţi voi mie treizeci de cămăşi şi treizeci de rânduri de haine". Au zis aceia: "Spune ghicitoarea ta, ca s-o auzim".
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐὰν μὴ δύνησθε ἀπαγγεῖλαί μοι, δώσετε ὑμεῖς ἐμοὶ τριάκοντα ὀθόνια καὶ τριάκοντα ἀλλασσομένας στολὰς ἱματίων· καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ, προβάλου τὸ πρόβλημά σου, καὶ ἀκουσόμεθα αὐτό.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎሙ ፡ እምነ ፡ በላዒ ፡ ወፅአ ፡ መብልዕ ፡ ወእምነ ፡ ጽኑዕ ፡ ወጽአ ፡ ጥዑም ፡ ወስእኑ ፡ አይድዖቶ ፡ አምሳሊሁ
                  ፡ እስከ ፡ ሠሉስ ፡ መዋዕል ።
verses.translation: And he said to them, Meat came forth of the eater, and sweetness out of the strong: and they could not tell the riddle for three days.

translations.lxx: And he said to them, Meat came forth of the eater, and sweetness out of the strong: and they could not tell the riddle for three days.
translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Out of the eater came forth meat, and out of the strong came forth sweetness. And they could not in three days expound the riddle.
translations.ron: Atunci le-a zis: "Din cel ce mănâncă a ieşit mâncare, şi din cel tare a ieşit dulceaţă". Şi n-au putut să dezlege ghicitoarea în trei zile.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς, τὶ βρωτὸν ἐξῆλθεν ἐκ βιβρώσκοντος, καὶ ἀπὸ ἰσχυροῦ γλυκύ· καὶ οὐκ ἠδύναντο ἀπαγγεῖλαι τὸ πρόβλημα ἐπὶ τρεῖς ἡμέρας.

verses.geez:
ወእምዝ ፡ አመ ፡ ራብዕት ፡ ዕለት ፡ ይቤልዋ ፡ ለብእሲተ ፡ ሶምሶን ፡ አስፍጥዮ ፡ ለምትኪ ፡ ወይንግርኪ ፡ አምሳሊሁ ፡
                  ከመ ፡ ኢናውዒክሙ ፡ በእሳት ፡ ለኪ ፡ ወለቤተ ፡ አቡኪ ፡ አው ፡ ከመ ፡ ታንድዩነኑ ፡ ጸዋዕክሙነ ።
verses.translation: And it came to pass on the fourth day, that they said to the wife of Sampson, Deceive now thy husband, and let him tell thee the riddle, lest we burn thee and thy father's house with fire: did ye invite us to do us violence?

translations.lxx: And it came to pass on the fourth day, that they said to the wife of Sampson, Deceive now thy husband, and let him tell thee the riddle, lest we burn thee and thy father's house with fire: did ye invite us to do us violence?
translations.kjv: And it came to pass on the seventh day, that they said unto Samson’s wife, Entice thy husband, that he may declare unto us the riddle, lest we burn thee and thy father’s house with fire: have ye called us to take that we have? is it not so?
translations.ron: Iar în ziua a şaptea au zis aceia către femeia lui Samson: "Ademeneşte pe bărbatul tău să dezlege ghicitoarea; altfel te vom arde cu foc pe tine şi casa tatălui tău; ne-aţi chemat, oare, ca să ne jefuiţi?"
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τετάρτῃ, καὶ εἶπαν τῇ γυναικὶ Σαμψὼν, ἀπάτησον δὴ τὸν ἄνδρα σου, καὶ ἀπαγγειλάτω σοι τὸ πρόβλημα, μή ποτε κατακαύσωμέν σε καὶ τὸν οἶκον τοῦ πατρός σου ἐν πυρί· ἢ ἐκβιᾶσαι ἡμᾶς κεκλήκατε;

verses.geez:
ወበከየት ፡ ላዕሌሁ ፡ ብእሲቱ ፡ ለሶምሶን ፡ ወትቤሎ ፡ ጸላእከኒ ፡ ወአታፈቅረኒ ፡ እስመ ፡ አምሳሊከ ፡ ዘመሰልከ ፡
                  ለደቂቀ ፡ ሕዝብየ ፡ ኢነገርከኒ ፡ ሊተ ፡ ወይቤላ ፡ ሶምሶን ፡ ናሁ ፡ ለአቡየ ፡ ወለእምየ ፡ ኢነገርክዎሙ ፡ ለኪኑ ፡ እንከ
                  ፡ እንግርኪ ።
verses.translation: And Sampson's wife wept before him, and said, Thou dost but hate me, and lovest me not; for the riddle which thou hast propounded to the children of my people, thou hast not told me: and Sampson said to her, If I have not told it to my father and my mother, shall I tell it to thee?

translations.lxx: And Sampson's wife wept before him, and said, Thou dost but hate me, and lovest me not; for the riddle which thou hast propounded to the children of my people, thou hast not told me: and Sampson said to her, If I have not told it to my father and my mother, shall I tell it to thee?
translations.kjv: And Samson’s wife wept before him, and said, Thou dost but hate me, and lovest me not: thou hast put forth a riddle unto the children of my people, and hast not told it me. And he said unto her, Behold, I have not told it my father nor my mother, and shall I tell it thee?
translations.ron: Şi a plâns femeia lui Samson înaintea lui, zicând: "Tu mă urăşti şi nu mă iubeşti; ai dat o ghicitoare fiilor poporului meu, iar mie nu mi-o dezlegi". Şi a zis el către ea: "Eu n-am dezlegat-o tatălui meu şi mamei mele şi să ţi-o dezleg ţie?"
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔκλαυσεν ἡ γυνὴ Σαμψὼν πρὸς αὐτὸν, καὶ εἶπε, πλὴν μεμίσηκάς με καὶ οὐκ ἠγάπησάς με, ὅτι τὸ πρόβλημα ὃ προεβάλου τοῖς υἱοῖς τοῦ λαοῦ μου, οὐκ ἀπήγγειλάς μοι αὐτό· καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ Σαμψὼν, εἰ τῷ πατρί μου καὶ τῇ μητρί μου οὐκ ἀπήγγελκα, σοὶ ἀπαγγείλω;

verses.geez:
ወበከየት ፡ ላዕሌሁ ፡ ሰቡዐ ፡ መዋዕለ ፡ ዘበዓል ፡ ወእምዝ ፡ አመ ፡ ሳብዕት ፡ ዕለት ፡ ነገራ ፡ ሶበ ፡ አስርሐቶ ፡
                  ወአይድዐቶሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ሕዝባ ።
verses.translation: And she wept before him the seven days, during which their banquet lasted: and it came to pass on the seventh day, that he told her, because she troubled him; and she told it to the children of her people.

translations.lxx: And she wept before him the seven days, during which their banquet lasted: and it came to pass on the seventh day, that he told her, because she troubled him; and she told it to the children of her people.
translations.kjv: And she wept before him the seven days, while their feast lasted: and it came to pass on the seventh day, that he told her, because she lay sore upon him: and she told the riddle to the children of her people.
translations.ron: Şi a plâns ea înaintea lui şapte zile, cât a ţinut ospăţul la ei. În sfârşit în ziua a şaptea i-a dezlegat-o căci ea îl ruga stăruitor.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔκλαυσε πρὸς αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὰς ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας, ἃς ἦν αὐτοῖς ὁ πότος· καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ, καὶ ἀπήγγειλεν αὐτῇ, ὅτι παρηνόχλησεν αὐτῷ· καὶ αὐτὴ ἀπήγγειλε τοῖς υἱοῖς τοῦ λαοῦ αὐτῆς.

verses.geez:
ወይቤልዎ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ዕደው ፡ አመ ፡ ሳብዕት ፡ ዕለት ፡ እንበለ ፡ ትዕረብ ፡ ፀሐይ ፡ ምንት ፡ ይጥዕም ፡ እምነ ፡
                  መዓር ፡ ወምንት ፡ ይጸንዕ ፡ እምነ ፡ አንበሳ ፡ ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ሶምሶን ፡ ሶበ ፡ ኢያስራሕክምዋ ፡ ለእጐልትየ ፡ እምኢረከብክምዋ
                  ፡ ለአምሳልየ ።
verses.translation: And the men of the city said to him on the seventh day, before sunrise, What is sweeter than honey? and what is stronger than a lion? and Sampson said to them, If ye had not ploughed with my heifer, ye would not have known my riddle.

translations.lxx: And the men of the city said to him on the seventh day, before sunrise, What is sweeter than honey? and what is stronger than a lion? and Sampson said to them, If ye had not ploughed with my heifer, ye would not have known my riddle.
translations.kjv: And the men of the city said unto him on the seventh day before the sun went down, What is sweeter than honey? And what is stronger than a lion? And he said unto them, If ye had not plowed with my heifer, ye had not found out my riddle.
translations.ron: Iar ea a spus dezlegarea ghicitorii fiilor poporului său. Şi iată în ziua a şaptea, înainte de răsăritul soarelui, au zis către oamenii cetăţii: "Ce e mai dulce ca mierea şi ce e mai tare ca leul?" Şi el le-a zis: "De nu aţi fi arat cu juninca mea, ghicitoarea mea n-o mai ghiceaţi voi".
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ οἱ ἄνδρες τῆς πόλεως ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ πρὸ τοῦ ἀνατεῖλαι τὸν ἥλιον, τί γλυκύτερον μέλιτος, καὶ τί ἰσχυρότερον λέοντος; καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Σαμψὼν, εἰ μὴ ἠροτριάσατε ἐν τῇ δαμάλει μου, οὐκ ἂν ἔγνωτε τὸ πρόβλημά μου.

verses.geez:
ወመጽአ ፡ መንፈሰ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ [ላዕሌሁ ፡] ወወረደ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ኦስቀሎና ፡ ወቀተለ ፡ ፴ብእሴ ፡ ወሠለቦሙ ፡
                  አልባሲሆሙ ፡ ወወሀቦሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ አይድዕዎ ፡ አምሳሊሁ ፡ ወተምዕዐ ፡ መዐተ ፡ ሶምሶን ፡ ወአተወ ፡ ቤተ ፡ አቡሁ ።
verses.translation: And the Spirit of the Lord came upon him powerfully, and he went down to Ascalon, and destroyed of the inhabitants thirty men, and took their garments, and gave the changes of raiment to them that told the riddle; and Sampson was very angry, and went up to the house of his father.

translations.lxx: And the Spirit of the Lord came upon him powerfully, and he went down to Ascalon, and destroyed of the inhabitants thirty men, and took their garments, and gave the changes of raiment to them that told the riddle; and Sampson was very angry, and went up to the house of his father.
translations.kjv: And the Spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he went down to Ashkelon, and slew thirty men of them, and took their spoil, and gave change of garments unto them which expounded the riddle. And his anger was kindled, and he went up to his father’s house.
translations.ron: Atunci s-a coborât peste el Duhul Domnului şi s-a dus în Ascalon şi, ucigând acolo treizeci de oameni, a dezbrăcat de pe ei hainele şi a dat rândurile de haine celor ce au ghicit ghicitoarea sa. Şi s-a aprins mânia lui şi s-a dus la casa tatălui său.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἥλατο ἐπʼ αὐτὸν πνεῦμα Κυρίου, καὶ κατέβη εἰς Ἀσκάλωνα, καὶ ἐπάταξεν ἐξ αὐτῶν τριάκοντα ἄνδρας, καὶ ἔλαβε τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτῶν, καὶ ἔδωκε τὰς στολὰς τοῖς ἀπαγγείλασι τὸ πρόβλημα· Καὶ ὠργίσθη θυμῷ Σαμψὼν, καὶ ἀνέβη εἰς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወነበረት ፡ ብእሲተ ፡ ሶምሶን ፡ ምስለ ፡ መጋቤ ፡ መርዓሁ ፡ ካልኡ ።
verses.translation: And the wife of Sampson was given to one of his friends, with whom he was on terms of friendship.

translations.lxx: And the wife of Sampson was given to one of his friends, with whom he was on terms of friendship.
translations.kjv: But Samson’s wife was given to his companion, whom he had used as his friend.
translations.ron: Iar femeia lui Samson s-a măritat cu unul din nuntaşii de la nunta sa, care au fost împrejurul lui.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἡ γυνὴ Σαμψὼν ἑνὶ τῶν φίλων αὐτοῦ, ὧν ἐφιλίασε.
